answer: Continuous Co-presence Sampling: identities earn standing only by answering randomized live challenges tied to a shared physical or network location, like a lotus traced across shifting water. Each pulse of verification requires participation in unpredictable joint tasks with neighbors. Missed checks decay standing; forged co-presence is caught by cross-checking. An attacker must staff every clone with a real participant across a reef of overlapping sessions, paying sustained human time per identity, not one-time capital.
